title: 20(S)-protopanaxadiol prolongs lifespan and enhances stress resistance in Caenorhabditis elegans via the insulin/IGF-1 signaling pathway.
authors: Song, Zhuo; Yan, Xiuci; Xu, Xiaohao; Lou, Tingting; Wang, Yu; Ren, Limei; Liu, Fangbing; Zhang, Shuai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷代谢物通过胰岛素/IGF-1信号通路延长线虫寿命，虽涉及分子对接但核心是衰老表型与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Aging is a progressive and irreversible process linked to a variety of diseases. Examination of the processes targeted by pharmacological treatments could potentially both extend lifespan and alleviate age-associated diseases. 20(S)-protopanaxadiol (20(S)-PPD), a primary ginsenoside metabolite, has many beneficial properties, although it;s anti-aging effects are unknown. METHODS: Lifespan and behavioral assays were used to determine the effects of 20(S)-PPD on life span and healthy lifespan. Stress resistance was systematically determined under heat, oxidative, and chemical stress conditions. The target of 20(S)-PPD was identified by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance. Investigation in mutant worms identified the signaling pathway and transcription factor mediating 20(S)-PPD-induced longevity. RESULTS: 20(S)-PPD could significantly extend Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans) lifespan without affecting food intake and reproductive output. It also improved healthspan in aging worms by ameliorating locomotor deficits and suppressing lipofuscin accumulation. Furthermore, 20(S)-PPD enhanced stress resistance and reduced age-associated reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. Mechanistically, 20(S)-PPD bound dose-dependently to the insulin receptor (IR) with a KD value of 8.59 muM. The life-extending effects of 20(S)-PPD involved the DAF-2/insulin/IGF-1 signaling (IIS) pathway, rather than other conserved pathways. Treatment with 20(S)-PPD promoted DAF-16/FOXO activation and nuclear translocation, leading to upregulated transcription of several antioxidant and detoxification-related genes, including lys-7, mtl-1, hsp-12.6, dod-3, sod-3, hsp-16.2, gst-4 and sms-1. 20(S)-PPD also upregulated the protein levels of SOD-3 and GST-4, known promoters of longevity in C. elegans. CONCLUSION: These findings demonstrate that IR is a molecular target of 20(S)-PPD and reveal a mechanism by which 20(S)-PPD promotes longevity and stress resistance, suggesting the potential of 20(S)-PPD in slowing aging and the development of age-associated disorders.
abstract_zh: 引言：衰老是一个进行性且不可逆的过程，与多种疾病相关。研究药理学治疗所靶向的过程可能既能延长寿命，又能缓解与年龄相关的疾病。20(S)-原人参二醇（20(S)-PPD）是一种主要的人参皂苷代谢物，具有许多有益特性，但其抗衰老作用尚不清楚。方法：采用寿命和行为学测定来确定20(S)-PPD对寿命和健康寿命的影响。在热应激、氧化应激和化学应激条件下系统测定其抗逆性。通过分子对接和表面等离子体共振鉴定20(S)-PPD的靶点。在突变体线虫中的研究确定了介导20(S)-PPD诱导长寿的信号通路和转录因子。结果：20(S)-PPD能显著延长秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）的寿命，且不影响摄食量和生殖产出。它通过改善运动缺陷和抑制脂褐素积累，改善了衰老线虫的健康寿命。此外，20(S)-PPD增强了抗逆性，并降低了与年龄相关的活性氧（ROS）水平。机制上，20(S)-PPD以剂量依赖性方式结合胰岛素受体（IR），KD值为8.59 μM。20(S)-PPD的延寿效应涉及DAF-2/胰岛素/IGF-1信号（IIS）通路，而非其他保守通路。20(S)-PPD处理促进了DAF-16/FOXO的激活和核转位，导致多个抗氧化和解毒相关基因（包括lys-7、mtl-1、hsp-12.6、dod-3、sod-3、hsp-16.2、gst-4和sms-1）的转录上调。20(S)-PPD还上调了SOD-3和GST-4的蛋白水平，这些是已知的C. elegans长寿促进因子。结论：这些发现表明IR是20(S)-PPD的分子靶点，并揭示了20(S)-PPD促进长寿和抗逆性的机制，提示20(S)-PPD在延缓衰老及与年龄相关疾病发展方面的潜力。
